text_en: The word of the Lord that came to Sophonias the son of Chusi, the son of Godolias, the son of Amarias, the son of Ezechias , in the days of Josias , the son of Amon king of Juda .
text_la: Verbum Domini quod factum est ad Sophoniam, filium Chusi, filii Godoliæ, filii Amariæ, filii Ezeciæ, in diebus Josiæ, filii Amon, regis Judæ.
text_pt: Palavra do SENHOR, que veio a Sofonias, filho de Cusi, filho de Gedalias, filho de Amarias, filho de Ezequias, nos dias de Josias, filho de Amom, rei de Judá.
text_el: λόγος κυρίου ὃς ἐγενήθη πρὸς Σοφονιαν τὸν τοῦ Χουσι υἱὸν Γοδολιου τοῦ Αμαριου τοῦ Εζεκιου ἐν ἡμέραις Ιωσιου υἱοῦ Αμων βασιλέως Ιουδα

text_en: Gathering, I will gather together all things from off the face of the land, says the Lord :
text_la: Congregans congregabo omnia a facie terræ, dicit Dominus :
text_pt: Hei de consumir por completo tudo de sobre a terra, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ἐκλείψει ἐκλιπέτω πάντα ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς γῆς λέγει κύριος

text_en: I will gather man , and beast, I will gather the birds of the air, and the fishes of the sea: and the ungodly shall meet with ruin: and I will destroy men from off the face of the land, says the Lord .
text_la: congregans hominem et pecus, congregans volatilia cæli et pisces maris : et ruinæ impiorum erunt, et disperdam homines a facie terræ, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Consumirei os homens e os animais, consumirei as aves do céu, e os peixes do mar, e os tropeços juntamente com os ímpios; e exterminarei os homens de sobre a terra, diz o Senhor.
text_el: ἐκλιπέτω ἄνθρωπος καὶ κτήνη ἐκλιπέτω τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ οἱ ἰχθύες τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ ἐξαρῶ τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς γῆς λέγει κύριος

text_en: And I will stretch out my hand upon Juda , and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem : and I will destroy out of this place the remnant of Baal , and the names of the wardens of the temples with the priests :
text_la: Et extendam manum meam super Judam et super omnes habitantes Jerusalem : et disperdam de loco hoc reliquias Baal, et nomina ædituorum cum sacerdotibus;
text_pt: E estenderei a minha mão contra Judá, e contra todos os habitantes de Jerusalém, e exterminarei deste lugar o restante de Baal, e o nome dos sacerdotes dos ídolos, juntamente com os sacerdotes;
text_el: καὶ ἐκτενῶ τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπὶ Ιουδαν καὶ ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐξαρῶ ἐκ τοῦ τόπου τούτου τὰ ὀνόματα τῆς Βααλ καὶ τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν ἱερέων

text_en: And them that worship the host of heaven upon the tops of houses, and them that adore , and swear by the Lord , and swear by Melchom.
text_la: et eos qui adorant super tecta militiam cæli, et adorant et jurant in Domino, et jurant in Melchom;
text_pt: E os que sobre os telhados adoram o exército do céu; e os que se inclinam jurando ao Senhor, e juram por Milcom;
text_el: καὶ τοὺς προσκυνοῦντας ἐπὶ τὰ δώματα τῇ στρατιᾷ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τοὺς ὀμνύοντας κατὰ τοῦ κυρίου καὶ τοὺς ὀμνύοντας κατὰ τοῦ βασιλέως αὐτῶν

text_en: And them that turn away from following after the Lord , and that have not sought the Lord , nor searched after him.
text_la: et qui avertuntur de post tergum Domini, et qui non quæsierunt Dominum, nec investigaverunt eum.
text_pt: E os que deixam de andar em seguimento do Senhor, e os que não buscam ao Senhor, nem perguntam por ele.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς ἐκκλίνοντας ἀπὸ τοῦ κυρίου καὶ τοὺς μὴ ζητήσαντας τὸν κύριον καὶ τοὺς μὴ ἀντεχομένους τοῦ κυρίου

text_en: Be silent before the face of the Lord God : for the day of the Lord is near, for the Lord has prepared a victim, he has sanctified his guests.
text_la: Silete a facie Domini Dei, quia juxta est dies Domini : quia præparavit Dominus hostiam; sanctificavit vocatos suos.
text_pt: Cala-te diante do Senhor DEUS, porque o dia do SENHOR está perto; porque o SENHOR preparou o sacrifício, e santificou os seus convidados.
text_el: εὐλαβεῖσθε ἀπὸ προσώπου κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ διότι ἐγγὺς ἡ ἡμέρα τοῦ κυρίου ὅτι ἡτοίμακεν κύριος τὴν θυσίαν αὐτοῦ ἡγίακεν τοὺς κλητοὺς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And it shall come to pass in the day of the victim of the Lord , that I will visit upon the princes, and upon the king's sons, and upon all such as are clothed with strange apparel:
text_la: Et erit : in die hostiæ Domini, visitabo super principes, et super filios regis, et super omnes qui induti sunt veste peregrina;
text_pt: Acontecerá que, no dia do sacrifício do Senhor, castigarei os príncipes, e os filhos do rei, e todos os que se vestem de trajes estrangeiros.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν ἡμέρᾳ θυσίας κυρίου καὶ ἐκδικήσω ἐπὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντας καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς ἐνδεδυμένους ἐνδύματα ἀλλότρια

text_en: And I will visit in that day upon every one that enters arrogantly over the threshold: them that fill the house of the Lord their God with iniquity and deceit .
text_la: et visitabo super omnem qui arroganter ingreditur super limen in die illa, qui complent domum Domini Dei sui iniquitate et dolo.
text_pt: Castigarei naquele dia todo aquele que salta sobre o limiar, que enche de violência e engano a casa dos seus senhores.
text_el: καὶ ἐκδικήσω ἐπὶ πάντας ἐμφανῶς ἐπὶ τὰ πρόπυλα ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοὺς πληροῦντας τὸν οἶκον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ αὐτῶν ἀσεβείας καὶ δόλου

text_en: And there shall be in that day, says the Lord , the noise of a cry from the fish gate, and a howling from the Second, and a great destruction from the hills.
text_la: Et erit in die illa, dicit Dominus, vox clamoris a porta piscium, et ululatus a Secunda, et contritio magna a collibus.
text_pt: E naquele dia, diz o Senhor, far-se-á ouvir uma voz de clamor desde a porta do peixe, e um uivo desde a segunda parte, e grande quebrantamento desde os outeiros.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ λέγει κύριος φωνὴ κραυγῆς ἀπὸ πύλης ἀποκεντούντων καὶ ὀλολυγμὸς ἀπὸ τῆς δευτέρας καὶ συντριμμὸς μέγας ἀπὸ τῶν βουνῶν

text_en: Howl, you inhabitants of the Morter. All the people of Chanaan is hush, all are cut off that were wrapped up in silver.
text_la: Ululate, habitatores Pilæ : conticuit omnis populus Chanaan, disperierunt omnes involuti argento.
text_pt: Uivai vós, moradores de Mactes, porque todo o povo que mercadejava está arruinado, todos os que estavam carregados de dinheiro foram destruídos.
text_el: θρηνήσατε οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὴν κατακεκομμένην ὅτι ὡμοιώθη πᾶς ὁ λαὸς Χανααν ἐξωλεθρεύθησαν πάντες οἱ ἐπηρμένοι ἀργυρίῳ

text_en: And it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and will visit upon the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their hearts: The Lord will not do good , nor will he do evil .
text_la: Et erit in tempore illo : scrutabor Jerusalem in lucernis, et visitabo super viros defixos in fæcibus suis, qui dicunt in cordibus suis : Non faciet bene Dominus, et non faciet male.
text_pt: E há de ser que, naquele tempo, esquadrinharei a Jerusalém com lanternas, e castigarei os homens que se espessam como a borra do vinho, que dizem no seu coração: O Senhor não faz o bem nem faz o mal.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐξερευνήσω τὴν Ιερουσαλημ μετὰ λύχνου καὶ ἐκδικήσω ἐπὶ τοὺς ἄνδρας τοὺς καταφρονοῦντας ἐπὶ τὰ φυλάγματα αὐτῶν οἱ λέγοντες ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν οὐ μὴ ἀγαθοποιήσῃ κύριος οὐδ' οὐ μὴ κακώσῃ

text_en: And their strength shall become a booty, and their houses as a desert : and they shall build houses, and shall not dwell in them: and they shall plant vineyards, and shall not drink the wine of them.
text_la: Et erit fortitudo eorum in direptionem, et domus eorum in desertum : et ædificabunt domos, et non habitabunt; et plantabunt vineas, et non bibent vinum earum.
text_pt: Por isso serão saqueados os seus bens, e assoladas as suas casas; e edificarão casas, mas não habitarão nelas, e plantarão vinhas, mas não lhes beberão o seu vinho.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἡ δύναμις αὐτῶν εἰς διαρπαγὴν καὶ οἱ οἶκοι αὐτῶν εἰς ἀφανισμόν καὶ οἰκοδομήσουσιν οἰκίας καὶ οὐ μὴ κατοικήσουσιν ἐν αὐταῖς καὶ καταφυτεύσουσιν ἀμπελῶνας καὶ οὐ μὴ πίωσιν τὸν οἶνον αὐτῶν

text_en: The great day of the Lord is near, it is near and exceeding swift: the voice of the day of the Lord is bitter, the mighty man shall there meet with tribulation.
text_la: Juxta est dies Domini magnus : juxta est, et velox nimis. Vox diei Domini amara : tribulabitur ibi fortis.
text_pt: O grande dia do Senhor está perto, sim, está perto, e se apressa muito; amarga é a voz do dia do Senhor; clamará ali o poderoso.
text_el: ὅτι ἐγγὺς ἡ ἡμέρα κυρίου ἡ μεγάλη ἐγγὺς καὶ ταχεῖα σφόδρα φωνὴ ἡμέρας κυρίου πικρὰ καὶ σκληρά τέτακται δυνατή

text_en: That day is a day of wrath , a day of tribulation and distress, a day of calamity and misery, a day of darkness and obscurity, a day of clouds and whirlwinds,
text_la: Dies iræ dies illa, dies tribulationis et angustiæ, dies calamitatis et miseriæ, dies tenebrarum et caliginis, dies nebulæ et turbinis,
text_pt: Aquele dia será um dia de indignação, dia de tribulação e de angústia, dia de alvoroço e de assolação, dia de trevas e de escuridão, dia de nuvens e de densas trevas,
text_el: ἡμέρα ὀργῆς ἡ ἡμέρα ἐκείνη ἡμέρα θλίψεως καὶ ἀνάγκης ἡμέρα ἀωρίας καὶ ἀφανισμοῦ ἡμέρα σκότους καὶ γνόφου ἡμέρα νεφέλης καὶ ὁμίχλης

text_en: a day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities, and against the high bulwarks.
text_la: dies tubæ et clangoris super civitates munitas, et super angulos excelsos.
text_pt: Dia de trombeta e de alarido contra as cidades fortificadas e contra as torres altas.
text_el: ἡμέρα σάλπιγγος καὶ κραυγῆς ἐπὶ τὰς πόλεις τὰς ὀχυρὰς καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς γωνίας τὰς ὑψηλάς

text_en: And I will distress men , and they shall walk like blind men , because they have sinned against the Lord : and their blood shall be poured out as earth, and their bodies as dung.
text_la: Et tribulabo homines, et ambulabunt ut cæci, quia Domino peccaverunt; et effundetur sanguis eorum sicut humus, et corpora eorum sicut stercora.
text_pt: E angustiarei os homens, que andarão como cegos, porque pecaram contra o Senhor; e o seu sangue se derramará como pó, e a sua carne será como esterco.
text_el: καὶ ἐκθλίψω τοὺς ἀνθρώπους καὶ πορεύσονται ὡς τυφλοί ὅτι τῷ κυρίῳ ἐξήμαρτον καὶ ἐκχεεῖ τὸ αἷμα αὐτῶν ὡς χοῦν καὶ τὰς σάρκας αὐτῶν ὡς βόλβιτα

text_en: Neither shall their silver and their gold be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the Lord : all the land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy : for he shall make even a speedy destruction of all them that dwell in the land.
text_la: Sed et argentum eorum et aurum eorum non poterit liberare eos in die iræ Domini : in igne zeli ejus devorabitur omnis terra, quia consummationem cum festinatione faciet cunctis habitantibus terram.
text_pt: Nem a sua prata nem o seu ouro os poderá livrar no dia da indignação do Senhor, mas pelo fogo do seu zelo toda esta terra será consumida, porque certamente fará de todos os moradores da terra uma destruição total e apressada.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ἀργύριον αὐτῶν καὶ τὸ χρυσίον αὐτῶν οὐ μὴ δύνηται ἐξελέσθαι αὐτοὺς ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ὀργῆς κυρίου καὶ ἐν πυρὶ ζήλους αὐτοῦ καταναλωθήσεται πᾶσα ἡ γῆ διότι συντέλειαν καὶ σπουδὴν ποιήσει ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν γῆν

text_en: Assemble yourselves together, be gathered together, O nation not worthy to be loved :
text_la: Convenite, congregamini, gens non amabilis,
text_pt: Congregai-vos, sim, congregai-vos, ó nação não desejável;
text_el: συνάχθητε καὶ συνδέθητε τὸ ἔθνος τὸ ἀπαίδευτον

text_en: Before the decree bring forth the day as dust passing away, before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you, before the day of the Lord's indignation come upon you.
text_la: priusquam pariat jussio quasi pulverem transeuntem diem, antequam veniat super vos ira furoris Domini, antequam veniat super vos dies indignationis Domini.
text_pt: Antes que o decreto produza o seu efeito, e o dia passe como a pragana; antes que venha sobre vós o furor da ira do Senhor, antes que venha sobre vós o dia da ira do Senhor.
text_el: πρὸ τοῦ γενέσθαι ὑμᾶς ὡς ἄνθος παραπορευόμενον πρὸ τοῦ ἐπελθεῖν ἐφ' ὑμᾶς ὀργὴν κυρίου πρὸ τοῦ ἐπελθεῖν ἐφ' ὑμᾶς ἡμέραν θυμοῦ κυρίου

text_en: Seek the Lord , all you meek of the earth, you that have wrought his judgment: seek the just , seek the meek: if by any means you may be hid in the day of the Lord's indignation.
text_la: Quærite Dominum, omnes mansueti terræ, qui judicium ejus estis operati; quærite justum, quærite mansuetum, si quomodo abscondamini in die furoris Domini.
text_pt: Buscai ao Senhor, vós todos os mansos da terra, que tendes posto por obra o seu juízo; buscai a justiça, buscai a mansidão; pode ser que sejais escondidos no dia da ira do Senhor.
text_el: ζητήσατε τὸν κύριον πάντες ταπεινοὶ γῆς κρίμα ἐργάζεσθε καὶ δικαιοσύνην ζητήσατε καὶ ἀποκρίνεσθε αὐτά ὅπως σκεπασθῆτε ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ὀργῆς κυρίου

text_en: For Gaza shall be destroyed, and Ascalon shall be a desert , they shall cast out Azotus at noonday, and Accaron shall be rooted up.
text_la: Quia Gaza destructa erit, et Ascalon in desertum : Azotum in meridie ejicient, et Accaron eradicabitur.
text_pt: Porque Gaza será desamparada, e Ascalom assolada; Asdode ao meio-dia será expelida, e Ecrom será desarraigada.
text_el: διότι Γάζα διηρπασμένη ἔσται καὶ Ἀσκαλὼν ἔσται εἰς ἀφανισμόν καὶ Ἄζωτος μεσημβρίας ἐκριφήσεται καὶ Ακκαρων ἐκριζωθήσεται

text_en: Woe to you that inhabit the sea coast, O nation of reprobates: the word of the Lord upon you, O Chanaan , the land of the Philistines , and I will destroy you, so that there shall not be an inhabitant.
text_la: Væ qui habitatis funiculum maris, gens perditorum! verbum Domini super vos, Chanaan, terra Philisthinorum; et disperdam te, ita ut non sit inhabitator.
text_pt: Ai dos habitantes da costa do mar, a nação dos quereteus! A palavra do Senhor será contra vós, ó Canaã, terra dos filisteus; e eu vos destruirei, até que não haja morador.
text_el: οὐαὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὸ σχοίνισμα τῆς θαλάσσης πάροικοι Κρητῶν λόγος κυρίου ἐφ' ὑμᾶς Χανααν γῆ ἀλλοφύλων καὶ ἀπολῶ ὑμᾶς ἐκ κατοικίας

text_en: And the sea coast shall be the resting place of shepherds, and folds for cattle:
text_la: Et erit funiculus maris requies pastorum, et caulæ pecorum;
text_pt: E a costa do mar será de pastos e cabanas para os pastores, e currais para os rebanhos.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται Κρήτη νομὴ ποιμνίων καὶ μάνδρα προβάτων

text_en: And it shall be the portion of him that shall remain of the house of Juda , there they shall feed: in the houses of Ascalon they shall rest in the evening: because the Lord their God will visit them, and bring back their captivity .
text_la: et erit funiculus ejus qui remanserit de domo Juda : ibi pascentur, in domibus Ascalonis ad vesperam requiescent, quia visitabit eos Dominus Deus eorum, et avertet captivitatem eorum.
text_pt: E será a costa para o restante da casa de Judá; ali apascentarão os seus rebanhos; de tarde se deitarão nas casas de Ascalom; porque o Senhor seu Deus os visitará, e os fará tornar do seu cativeiro.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται τὸ σχοίνισμα τῆς θαλάσσης τοῖς καταλοίποις οἴκου Ιουδα ἐπ' αὐτοὺς νεμήσονται ἐν τοῖς οἴκοις Ἀσκαλῶνος δείλης καταλύσουσιν ἀπὸ προσώπου υἱῶν Ιουδα ὅτι ἐπέσκεπται αὐτοὺς κύριος ὁ θεὸς αὐτῶν καὶ ἀπέστρεψε τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν αὐτῶν

text_en: I have heard the reproach of Moab , and the blasphemies of the children of Ammon , with which they reproached my people, and have magnified themselves upon their borders.
text_la: Audivi opprobrium Moab, et blasphemias filiorum Ammon, quæ exprobraverunt populo meo, et magnificati sunt super terminos eorum.
text_pt: Eu ouvi o escárnio de Moabe, e as injuriosas palavras dos filhos de Amom, com que escarneceram do meu povo, e se engrandeceram contra o seu termo.
text_el: ἤκουσα ὀνειδισμοὺς Μωαβ καὶ κονδυλισμοὺς υἱῶν Αμμων ἐν οἷς ὠνείδιζον τὸν λαόν μου καὶ ἐμεγαλύνοντο ἐπὶ τὰ ὅριά μου

text_en: Therefore as I live, says the Lord of hosts the God of Israel , Moab shall be as Sodom , and the children of Ammon as Gomorrha , the dryness of thorns, and heaps of salt , and a desert even for ever: the remnant of my people shall make a spoil of them, and the residue of my nation shall possess them.
text_la: Propterea vivo ego, dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israël, quia Moab ut Sodoma erit, et filii Ammon quasi Gomorrha : siccitas spinarum, et acervi salis, et desertum usque in æternum : reliquiæ populi mei diripient eos, et residui gentis meæ possidebunt illos.
text_pt: Portanto, tão certo como eu vivo, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel, Moabe será como Sodoma, e os filhos de Amom como Gomorra, campo de urtigas e poços de sal, e desolação perpétua; o restante do meu povo os saqueará, e o restante do meu povo os possuirá.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ζῶ ἐγώ λέγει κύριος τῶν δυνάμεων ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ διότι Μωαβ ὡς Σοδομα ἔσται καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Αμμων ὡς Γομορρα καὶ Δαμασκὸς ἐκλελειμμένη ὡς θιμωνιὰ ἅλωνος καὶ ἠφανισμένη εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ οἱ κατάλοιποι λαοῦ μου διαρπῶνται αὐτούς καὶ οἱ κατάλοιποι ἔθνους μου κληρονομήσουσιν αὐτούς

text_en: This shall befall them for their pride : because they have blasphemed , and have been magnified against the people of the Lord of hosts .
text_la: Hoc eis eveniet pro superbia sua, quia blasphemaverunt et magnificati sunt super populum Domini exercituum.
text_pt: Isso terão em recompensa da sua soberba, porque escarneceram, e se engrandeceram contra o povo do Senhor dos Exércitos.
text_el: αὕτη αὐτοῖς ἀντὶ τῆς ὕβρεως αὐτῶν διότι ὠνείδισαν καὶ ἐμεγαλύνθησαν ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον τὸν παντοκράτορα

text_en: The Lord shall be terrible upon them, and shall consume all the gods of the earth: and they shall adore him every man from his own place, all the islands of the Gentiles .
text_la: Horribilis Dominus super eos, et attenuabit omnes deos terræ : et adorabunt eum viri de loco suo, omnes insulæ gentium.
text_pt: O Senhor será terrível para eles, porque emagrecerá todos os deuses da terra; e todos virão adorá-lo, cada um desde o seu lugar, de todas as ilhas dos gentios.
text_el: ἐπιφανήσεται κύριος ἐπ' αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσει πάντας τοὺς θεοὺς τῶν ἐθνῶν τῆς γῆς καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν αὐτῷ ἕκαστος ἐκ τοῦ τόπου αὐτοῦ πᾶσαι αἱ νῆσοι τῶν ἐθνῶν

text_en: You Ethiopians , also shall be slain with my sword.
text_la: Sed et vos, Æthiopes, interfecti gladio meo eritis.
text_pt: Também vós, ó etíopes, sereis mortos com a minha espada.
text_el: καὶ ὑμεῖς Αἰθίοπες τραυματίαι ῥομφαίας μού ἐστε

text_en: And he will stretch out his hand upon the north, and will destroy Assyria : and he will make the beautiful city a wilderness , and as a place not passable, and as a desert .
text_la: Et extendet manum suam super aquilonem, et perdet Assur, et ponet speciosam in solitudinem, et in invium, et quasi desertum.
text_pt: Estenderá também a sua mão contra o norte, e destruirá a Assíria; e fará de Nínive uma desolação, terra seca como o deserto.
text_el: καὶ ἐκτενεῖ τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ βορρᾶν καὶ ἀπολεῖ τὸν Ἀσσύριον καὶ θήσει τὴν Νινευη εἰς ἀφανισμὸν ἄνυδρον ὡς ἔρημον

text_en: And flocks shall lie down in the midst thereof, all the beasts of the nations: and the bittern and the urchin shall lodge in the threshold thereof: the voice of the singing bird in the window, the raven on the upper post, for I will consume her strength.
text_la: Et accubabunt in medio ejus greges, omnes bestiæ gentium; et onocrotalus et ericius in liminibus ejus morabuntur : vox cantantis in fenestra, corvus in superliminari, quoniam attenuabo robur ejus.
text_pt: E no meio dela repousarão os rebanhos, todos os animais das nações; e alojar-se-ão nos seus capitéis assim o pelicano como o ouriço; o canto das aves se ouvirá nas janelas; e haverá desolação nos limiares, quando tiver descoberto a sua obra de cedro.
text_el: καὶ νεμήσονται ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς ποίμνια καὶ πάντα τὰ θηρία τῆς γῆς καὶ χαμαιλέοντες καὶ ἐχῖνοι ἐν τοῖς φατνώμασιν αὐτῆς κοιτασθήσονται καὶ θηρία φωνήσει ἐν τοῖς διορύγμασιν αὐτῆς κόρακες ἐν τοῖς πυλῶσιν αὐτῆς διότι κέδρος τὸ ἀνάστημα αὐτῆς

text_en: This is the glorious city that dwelt in security: that said in her heart: I am, and there is none beside me: how is she become a desert , a place for beasts to lie down in? Every one that passes by her shall hiss, and wag his hand.
text_la: Hæc est civitas gloriosa habitans in confidentia, quæ dicebat in corde suo : Ego sum, et extra me non est alia amplius : quomodo facta est in desertum cubile bestiæ? omnis qui transit per eam sibilabit, et movebit manum suam.
text_pt: Esta é a cidade alegre, que habita despreocupadamente, que diz no seu coração: Eu sou, e não há outra além de mim; como se tornou em desolação, em pousada de animais! Todo o que passar por ela assobiará, e meneará a sua mão.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ πόλις ἡ φαυλίστρια ἡ κατοικοῦσα ἐπ' ἐλπίδι ἡ λέγουσα ἐν καρδίᾳ αὐτῆς ἐγώ εἰμι καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν μετ' ἐμὲ ἔτι πῶς ἐγενήθη εἰς ἀφανισμόν νομὴ θηρίων πᾶς ὁ διαπορευόμενος δι' αὐτῆς συριεῖ καὶ κινήσει τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ

text_en: Woe to the provoking and redeemed city, the dove .
text_la: Væ provocatrix, et redempta civitas, columba!
text_pt: Ai da rebelde e contaminada, da cidade opressora!
text_el: ὦ ἡ ἐπιφανὴς καὶ ἀπολελυτρωμένη ἡ πόλις ἡ περιστερά

text_en: She has not hearkened to the voice, neither has she received discipline: she has not trusted in the Lord , she drew not near to her God .
text_la: non audivit vocem, et non suscepit disciplinam; in Domino non est confisa, ad Deum suum non appropinquavit.
text_pt: Não obedeceu à sua voz, não aceitou o castigo; não confiou no Senhor; nem se aproximou do seu Deus.
text_el: οὐκ εἰσήκουσεν φωνῆς οὐκ ἐδέξατο παιδείαν ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ οὐκ ἐπεποίθει καὶ πρὸς τὸν θεὸν αὐτῆς οὐκ ἤγγισεν

text_en: Her princes are in the midst of her as roaring lions: her judges are evening wolves, they left nothing for the morning.
text_la: Principes ejus in medio ejus quasi leones rugientes; judices ejus lupi vespere, non relinquebant in mane.
text_pt: Os seus príncipes são leões rugidores no meio dela; os seus juízes são lobos da tarde, que não deixam os ossos para a manhã.
text_el: οἱ ἄρχοντες αὐτῆς ἐν αὐτῇ ὡς λέοντες ὠρυόμενοι οἱ κριταὶ αὐτῆς ὡς λύκοι τῆς Ἀραβίας οὐχ ὑπελίποντο εἰς τὸ πρωί

text_en: Her prophets are senseless, men without faith : her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have acted unjustly against the law .
text_la: Prophetæ ejus vesani, viri infideles; sacerdotes ejus polluerunt sanctum, injuste egerunt contra legem.
text_pt: Os seus profetas são levianos, homens aleivosos; os seus sacerdotes profanaram o santuário, e fizeram violência à lei.
text_el: οἱ προφῆται αὐτῆς πνευματοφόροι ἄνδρες καταφρονηταί οἱ ἱερεῖς αὐτῆς βεβηλοῦσιν τὰ ἅγια καὶ ἀσεβοῦσιν νόμον

text_en: The just Lord is in the midst thereof, he will not do iniquity : in the morning, in the morning he will bring his judgment to light, and it shall not be hid: but the wicked man has not known shame.
text_la: Dominus justus in medio ejus non faciet iniquitatem; mane, mane judicium suum dabit in lucem, et non abscondetur; nescivit autem iniquus confusionem.
text_pt: O Senhor é justo no meio dela; ele não comete iniqüidade; cada manhã traz o seu juízo à luz; nunca falta; mas o perverso não conhece a vergonha.
text_el: ὁ δὲ κύριος δίκαιος ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς καὶ οὐ μὴ ποιήσῃ ἄδικον πρωὶ πρωὶ δώσει κρίμα αὐτοῦ εἰς φῶς καὶ οὐκ ἀπεκρύβη καὶ οὐκ ἔγνω ἀδικίαν ἐν ἀπαιτήσει καὶ οὐκ εἰς νεῖκος ἀδικίαν

text_en: I have destroyed the nations , and their towers are beaten down: I have made their ways desert , so that there is none that passes by: their cities are desolate, there is not a man remaining, nor any inhabitant.
text_la: Disperdidi gentes, et dissipati sunt anguli earum; desertas feci vias eorum, dum non est qui transeat; desolatæ sunt civitates eorum, non remanente viro, neque ullo habitatore.
text_pt: Exterminei as nações, as suas torres estão assoladas; fiz desertas as suas praças, a ponto de não ficar quem passe por elas; as suas cidades foram destruídas, até não ficar ninguém, até não haver quem as habite.
text_el: ἐν διαφθορᾷ κατέσπασα ὑπερηφάνους ἠφανίσθησαν γωνίαι αὐτῶν ἐξερημώσω τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῶν τὸ παράπαν τοῦ μὴ διοδεύειν ἐξέλιπον αἱ πόλεις αὐτῶν παρὰ τὸ μηδένα ὑπάρχειν μηδὲ κατοικεῖν

text_en: I said: Surely you will fear me, you will receive correction: and her dwelling shall not perish, for all things wherein I have visited her: but they rose early, and corrupted all their thoughts.
text_la: Dixi : Attamen timebis me, suscipies disciplinam; et non peribit habitaculum ejus, propter omnia in quibus visitavi eam : verumtamen diluculo surgentes corruperunt omnes cogitationes suas.
text_pt: Eu dizia: Certamente me temerás, e aceitarás a correção, e assim a sua morada não seria destruída, conforme tudo aquilo porque a castiguei; mas eles se levantaram de madrugada, corromperam todas as suas obras.
text_el: εἶπα πλὴν φοβεῖσθέ με καὶ δέξασθε παιδείαν καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐξολεθρευθῆτε ἐξ ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῆς πάντα ὅσα ἐξεδίκησα ἐπ' αὐτήν ἑτοιμάζου ὄρθρισον διέφθαρται πᾶσα ἡ ἐπιφυλλὶς αὐτῶν

text_en: Wherefore expect me, says the Lord , in the day of my resurrection that is to come, for my judgment is to assemble the Gentiles , and to gather the kingdoms: and to pour upon them my indignation, all my fierce anger : for with the fire of my jealousy shall all the earth be devoured.
text_la: Quapropter exspecta me, dicit Dominus, in die resurrectionis meæ in futurum : quia judicium meum ut congregem gentes, et colligam regna, et effundam super eos indignationem meam, omnem iram furoris mei : in igne enim zeli mei devorabitur omnis terra.
text_pt: Portanto esperai-me, diz o Senhor, no dia em que eu me levantar para o despojo; porque o meu decreto é ajuntar as nações e congregar os reinos, para sobre eles derramar a minha indignação, e todo o ardor da minha ira; porque toda esta terra será consumida pelo fogo do meu zelo.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ὑπόμεινόν με λέγει κύριος εἰς ἡμέραν ἀναστάσεώς μου εἰς μαρτύριον διότι τὸ κρίμα μου εἰς συναγωγὰς ἐθνῶν τοῦ εἰσδέξασθαι βασιλεῖς τοῦ ἐκχέαι ἐπ' αὐτοὺς πᾶσαν ὀργὴν θυμοῦ μου διότι ἐν πυρὶ ζήλους μου καταναλωθήσεται πᾶσα ἡ γῆ

text_en: Because then I will restore to the people a chosen lip, that all may call upon the name of the Lord , and may serve him with one shoulder.
text_la: Quia tunc reddam populis labium electum, ut invocent omnes in nomine Domini, et serviant ei humero uno.
text_pt: Porque então darei uma linguagem pura aos povos, para que todos invoquem o nome do Senhor, para que o sirvam com um mesmo consenso.
text_el: ὅτι τότε μεταστρέψω ἐπὶ λαοὺς γλῶσσαν εἰς γενεὰν αὐτῆς τοῦ ἐπικαλεῖσθαι πάντας τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου τοῦ δουλεύειν αὐτῷ ὑπὸ ζυγὸν ἕνα

text_en: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia , shall my suppliants, the children of my dispersed people, bring me an offering .
text_la: Ultra flumina Æthiopiæ, inde supplices mei; filii dispersorum meorum deferent munus mihi.
text_pt: Dalém dos rios da Etiópia, meus zelosos adoradores, que constituem a filha dos meus dispersos, me trarão sacrifício.
text_el: ἐκ περάτων ποταμῶν Αἰθιοπίας οἴσουσιν θυσίας μοι

text_en: In that day you shall not be ashamed for all your doings, wherein you have transgressed against me for then I will take away out of the midst of you your proud boasters, and you shall no more be lifted up because of my holy mountain.
text_la: In die illa non confunderis super cunctis adinventionibus tuis, quibus prævaricata es in me, quia tunc auferam de medio tui magniloquos superbiæ tuæ, et non adjicies exaltari amplius in monte sancto meo.
text_pt: Naquele dia não te envergonharás de nenhuma das tuas obras, com as quais te rebelaste contra mim; porque então tirarei do meio de ti os que exultam na tua soberba, e tu nunca mais te ensoberbecerás no meu monte santo.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ οὐ μὴ καταισχυνθῇς ἐκ πάντων τῶν ἐπιτηδευμάτων σου ὧν ἠσέβησας εἰς ἐμέ ὅτι τότε περιελῶ ἀπὸ σοῦ τὰ φαυλίσματα τῆς ὕβρεώς σου καὶ οὐκέτι μὴ προσθῇς τοῦ μεγαλαυχῆσαι ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος τὸ ἅγιόν μου

text_en: And I will leave in the midst of you a poor and needy people: and they shall hope in the name of the Lord .
text_la: Et derelinquam in medio tui populum pauperem et egenum : et sperabunt in nomine Domini.
text_pt: Mas deixarei no meio de ti um povo humilde e pobre; e eles confiarão no nome do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ὑπολείψομαι ἐν σοὶ λαὸν πραῢν καὶ ταπεινόν καὶ εὐλαβηθήσονται ἀπὸ τοῦ ὀνόματος κυρίου

text_en: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity , nor speak lies , nor shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed, and shall lie down, and there shall be none to make them afraid .
text_la: Reliquiæ Israël non facient iniquitatem, nec loquentur mendacium, et non invenietur in ore eorum lingua dolosa, quoniam ipsi pascentur, et accubabunt, et non erit qui exterreat.
text_pt: O remanescente de Israel não cometerá iniqüidade, nem proferirá mentira, e na sua boca não se achará língua enganosa; mas serão apascentados, e deitar-se-ão, e não haverá quem os espante.
text_el: οἱ κατάλοιποι τοῦ Ισραηλ καὶ οὐ ποιήσουσιν ἀδικίαν καὶ οὐ λαλήσουσιν μάταια καὶ οὐ μὴ εὑρεθῇ ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν γλῶσσα δολία διότι αὐτοὶ νεμήσονται καὶ κοιτασθήσονται καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ ἐκφοβῶν αὐτούς

text_en: Give praise, O daughter of Sion : shout, O Israel : be glad , and rejoice with all your heart, O daughter of Jerusalem .
text_la: Lauda, filia Sion; jubila, Israël : lætare, et exsulta in omni corde, filia Jerusalem.
text_pt: Canta alegremente, ó filha de Sião; rejubila, ó Israel; regozija- te, e exulta de todo o coração, ó filha de Jerusalém.
text_el: χαῖρε σφόδρα θύγατερ Σιων κήρυσσε θύγατερ Ιερουσαλημ εὐφραίνου καὶ κατατέρπου ἐξ ὅλης τῆς καρδίας σου θύγατερ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: The Lord has taken away your judgment, he has turned away your enemies: the king of Israel , the Lord , is in the midst of you, you shall fear evil no more.
text_la: Abstulit Dominus judicium tuum; avertit inimicos tuos. Rex Israël Dominus in medio tui : non timebis malum ultra.
text_pt: O Senhor afastou os teus juízos, exterminou o teu inimigo; o Senhor, o rei de Israel, está no meio de ti; tu não verás mais mal algum.
text_el: περιεῖλεν κύριος τὰ ἀδικήματά σου λελύτρωταί σε ἐκ χειρὸς ἐχθρῶν σου βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ κύριος ἐν μέσῳ σου οὐκ ὄψῃ κακὰ οὐκέτι

text_en: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem : Fear not: to Sion : Let not your hands be weakened.
text_la: In die illa dicetur Jerusalem : Noli timere; Sion : Non dissolvantur manus tuæ.
text_pt: Naquele dia se dirá a Jerusalém: Não temas, ó Sião, não se enfraqueçam as tuas mãos.
text_el: ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ἐρεῖ κύριος τῇ Ιερουσαλημ θάρσει Σιων μὴ παρείσθωσαν αἱ χεῖρές σου

text_en: The Lord your God in the midst of you is mighty, he will save: he will rejoice over you with gladness, he will be silent in his love , he will be joyful over you in praise.
text_la: Dominus Deus tuus in medio tui fortis, ipse salvabit : gaudebit super te in lætitia, silebit in dilectione sua, exsultabit super te in laude.
text_pt: O Senhor teu Deus, o poderoso, está no meio de ti, ele salvará; ele se deleitará em ti com alegria; calar-se-á por seu amor, regozijar-se-á em ti com júbilo.
text_el: κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐν σοί δυνατὸς σώσει σε ἐπάξει ἐπὶ σὲ εὐφροσύνην καὶ καινιεῖ σε ἐν τῇ ἀγαπήσει αὐτοῦ καὶ εὐφρανθήσεται ἐπὶ σὲ ἐν τέρψει ὡς ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἑορτῆς

text_en: The triflers that were departed from the law , I will gather together, because they were of you: that you may no more suffer reproach for them.
text_la: Nugas, qui a lege recesserant, congregabo, quia ex te erant : ut non ultra habeas super eis opprobrium.
text_pt: Os entristecidos por causa da reunião solene, congregarei; esses que são de ti e para os quais o opróbrio dela era um peso.
text_el: καὶ συνάξω τοὺς συντετριμμένους οὐαί τίς ἔλαβεν ἐπ' αὐτὴν ὀνειδισμόν

text_en: Behold I will cut off all that have afflicted you at that time: and I will save her that halts, and will gather her that was cast out: and I will get them praise, and a name, in all the land where they had been put to confusion.
text_la: Ecce ego interficiam omnes qui afflixerunt te in tempore illo : et salvabo claudicantem, et eam quæ ejecta fuerat congregabo : et ponam eos in laudem, et in nomen, in omni terra confusionis eorum,
text_pt: Eis que naquele tempo procederei contra todos os que te afligem, e salvarei a que coxeia, e recolherei a que foi expulsa; e deles farei um louvor e um nome em toda a terra em que foram envergonhados.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ποιῶ ἐν σοὶ ἕνεκεν σοῦ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ λέγει κύριος καὶ σώσω τὴν ἐκπεπιεσμένην καὶ τὴν ἀπωσμένην εἰσδέξομαι καὶ θήσομαι αὐτοὺς εἰς καύχημα καὶ ὀνομαστοὺς ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ

text_en: At that time, when I will bring you: and at the time that I will gather you: for I will give you a name, and praise among all the people of the earth, when I shall have brought back your captivity before your eyes, says the Lord .
text_la: in tempore illo quo adducam vos, et in tempore quo congregabo vos. Dabo enim vos in nomen, et in laudem omnibus populis terræ, cum convertero captivitatem vestram coram oculis vestris, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Naquele tempo vos farei voltar, naquele tempo vos recolherei; certamente farei de vós um nome e um louvor entre todos os povos da terra, quando fizer voltar os vossos cativos diante dos vossos olhos, diz o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ καταισχυνθήσονται ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ὅταν καλῶς ὑμῖν ποιήσω καὶ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ὅταν εἰσδέξωμαι ὑμᾶς διότι δώσω ὑμᾶς ὀνομαστοὺς καὶ εἰς καύχημα ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς λαοῖς τῆς γῆς ἐν τῷ ἐπιστρέφειν με τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν ὑμῶν ἐνώπιον ὑμῶν λέγει κύριος
